data.startFromHint: Optionally copy metrics, grouping, and display settings from a recipe or published widget.

metrics.chosenHint: Select 1 to 4 compatible metrics and arrange their display order.
metrics.addMetricHint: Search available metrics for the selected source. Locked items show why they are unavailable.
metrics.noMetrics: No metrics match the current source and search.
metrics.noSourceFirst: Choose a source in the Data step to browse its metrics.
metrics.groupByHint: Primary category or time dimension used to group the results.
metrics.grainHint: Time interval used when grouping by time.
metrics.splitByHint: Optional secondary dimension to break each group into series.
metrics.topNHint: Maximum number of split categories to show (1 to 50).
metrics.groupRestHint: Combine categories outside the top items into a single Other series.
metrics.calcRatioHint: Sum of the first ÷ sum of the second, over the whole period.
metrics.calcDiffHint: Sum of the first − sum of the second, over the whole period.
metrics.calcOperandHint: Compatible metric used as the second operand in this calculation.

scope.periodHint: Default date range used whenever this widget runs.
scope.customRangeHint: Choose exact start and end dates for the custom period.
scope.basisHint: How records are anchored in time for the first selected metric.
scope.dataScopeHint: Choose whether the widget follows the viewer's permissions or fixes specific branches.
scope.scopeBranchesHint: Select at least one branch included in this fixed scope.
scope.branchHint: Optional branch filter applied by default to this widget.
scope.pipelineHint: Optional sales pipeline filter supported by this metric.
scope.currencyHint: Select a single currency so monetary figures are never mixed.
scope.staleDaysHint: Number of inactive days before a record counts as stale (1 to 365).
scope.closingWindowDaysHint: Upcoming window in days used for expected close calculations (1 to 365).
scope.filterRulesHint: Additional record conditions combined into the widget query before aggregation.
